src/browser-admission.ts.name: Napplet admission
src/browser-admission.ts.description: Holds a napplet's page until its required permissions are decided, then commits the exact grants, script and security policy.

src/browser-approval-dom.ts.name: Dialog element helpers
src/browser-approval-dom.ts.description: Builds dialog elements and choice lists without inserting raw HTML.

src/browser-approval-format.ts.name: Approval wording
src/browser-approval-format.ts.description: Holds the wording for grant lifetimes and rule actions and formats napplet identities for display.

src/browser-approval-grants.ts.name: Granted permissions list
src/browser-approval-grants.ts.description: Shows current grants as a tree of napplet, interface and grant, with controls to manage them.

src/browser-approval-prompt.ts.name: Permission question
src/browser-approval-prompt.ts.description: Asks the user one permission question at a time, and can offer to make the answer a standing rule.

src/browser-approval-rules.ts.name: Default rules editor
src/browser-approval-rules.ts.description: Lets the user set a default answer and per-interface exceptions; the host decides where rules are kept.

src/browser-approval-styles.ts.name: Approval dialog styles
src/browser-approval-styles.ts.description: The stylesheet for the permission dialogs and lists.

src/browser-approval-ui.ts.name: Approval interface
src/browser-approval-ui.ts.description: Combines the question, grant list and rules editor into one ready-made permission interface wired to the runtime.
